Loss report: woodpecker -> argo
[external] pipeline/woodpecker/job/ci/step/source-checkout step.action: input git artifact at /workspace (the ctx-repo and ctx-sha workflow parameters carry the repository and the commit; a private repository needs credentials on the git artifact, which the file does not set; a private repository needs usernameSecret and passwordSecret, or sshPrivateKeySecret, on the git artifact; the file names none)
[external] pipeline/woodpecker/trigger/0 trigger.push: EventSource webhook secret (Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token must exist and match the GitHub webhook; the repository owner and name are placeholders; set them in the EventSource)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker/job/ci/step/publish step.action: plugin image with PLUGIN_ variables (the settings are passed as PLUGIN_<NAME> variables, the Woodpecker convention; a list of scalars is comma-joined, any other list or map is JSON; the image entrypoint runs and the container has no command; the plugin starts a Docker daemon, so it sets securityContext.privileged: true and the cluster policy must admit privileged pods)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches
